Jamia Millia Islamia Forms Committee for Students' Union Constitution

Jamia Millia Islamia has formed a committee tasked with drafting a constitution for a students' union. This development occurs amidst ongoing protests related to the union. One perspective from a Jamia student questions the arguments against forming a union, framing them as outdated.
